text:
lina: Heads-up — customer reported a connector returned a response that passes model-level checks but failed our schema gate and got routed to degen. They saw `error: invalid shape` and were billed.

samir: Which connector + model? Any sample logs?

lina: Model: open-sim-1, connector: jira-create. Raw payload we received: `{"action":"create_ticket","args":["proj-123","Fix bug"]}`

andre: Our schema expects `args` to be an object `{project_id, summary}` not an array. Router enforces schema strictly and falls back to degen.

megan: Console issue: we show token & cost but not the reject_reason. Customer emailed confused about being charged when the router fell back.

samir: Billing note: we bill for primary attempt tokens; fallback attempts also bill. We don't currently auto-credit rejects.

dev-bot: :warning: Canary alert: schema_rejects rate > 5/min on prod-cluster-3 (5m window)

lina: Proposal: add `reject_reason` and `validation_hint` to routing traces and surface in Console per-request detail plus a small human tooltip like "structured output mismatch".

andre: Implementation idea: enrich trace span with `validator.reason` and emit metric `schema_reject.v1{route,model,cluster}`. Also add adapter-level coercion hooks that try lightweight transforms (array->object coercion) before routing to degen.

megan: UI ask: if we expose per-request rejects, need rollout toggle (off by default) and strict redaction rules — customers should never see raw payload without opt-in.

terry: Rollout suggestion: `soft-validate` mode. Router adds header `x-validate-mode: soft` which runs validator but doesn't change consumer-visible path. Attach `validation.score` and `coerced=true` if adapter fixed it. Sample config: 

```
validation:
  mode: soft
  sample_rate: 0.05
  coercion: [array_to_object, enum_coerce]
```

samir: Metrics/rollout plan: 1) enable soft validate 5% global, 2) collect `schema_reject` vs `coercion_success`, 3) if coercion_success > 90% and no QoS regressions -> consider stricter enforcement.

lina: Edge cases: adapters that change semantics (e.g., mapping array->object with guessed keys) must be disabled by default for enterprise customers; need consent.

andre: Action: I'll prototype span + metric and a small adapter library with reversible coercions.

terry: I'll draft router header spec + sampling behaviour and the config knobs.

megan: I'll mock Console UI: per-request details with redacted payload, a tooltip for the reject reason, and a toggle in org settings. Also a privacy doc blurb.

samir: I'll update billing docs and add a support playbook for credited rejects.

lina: Sync in 35m to review prototypes. Thanks.
